description: Hardware monitoring overlay for CPU, GPU, memory, temperatures, clocks, power, network, disk activity, and FPS.
notes: The official setup.iss identifies PulseSetup.exe as an Inno Setup installer. Scoop uses innosetup extraction and does not execute the vendor setup sections.
The [Files] section places Pulse.exe and its application DLLs directly under {app}; it also bundles PresentMon and PawnIO_setup.exe.
Pulse.exe itself requests Administrator privileges. The installer's optional PawnIO sensor-driver task is not run by Scoop extraction; the driver is not installed by this manifest.
The application is published as a self-contained .NET 10 x64 build, so a separate .NET runtime is not required.
